OfficerDetail: V A T V KUMAR (DDIT UNIT 2-2)
remarks:
In the petition, the petitioner mentioned various central government departments and investigation agencies stating that they processed his appeals and grant him reward under Income Tax Reward Scheme and attached all the correspondence made by him with various offices. 
On examination of the grievance filed and the attachments enclosed, it is submitted that the petitioner is filing vague petitions and is requesting to grant rewards for the petitions filed by him. In this regard, it is submitted that Reward is given based on the detection of undisclosed income on the basis of information provided by the petitioner. However, in the present case, the petitioner filed grievance seeking reward as per Income Tax Reward Scheme to help and support his unemployment and poverty referring to earlier petitions filed by him with various officers and investigation agencies which were already disposed.
 Since no new information was provided by the petitioner in grievance excepting requesting the interim reward as per Income Tax Reward Scheme, the question of reward does not arise and his grievance petition is disposed accordingly.

मुख्य अग्नि शमन अधिकारी नैनीताल द्वारा लिखित रिपोर्ट में स्थलीय निरीक्षण के दौरान भवन निर्माणाधीन अवस्था में था भवन के सील बंद होने की कोई स्थिति नही लग रही थी जिसके आधार पर निर्माण कर्ता को अनापत्ति पत्र निर्गत किया गया ।
इस लोक निर्माण विभाग की भूमि पर हो रहे अवैध निर्माण को हटने एवं विभाग द्वारा निर्गत किए अनापत्ति पत्र को निरस्त करने के आदेश देने की कृपा करें

साथ ही एल 01 अधिकारी पुंडीर जी को भी फ़ोन से सम्पर्क कर सारे साक्ष्य उनको भेजे और उनसे पूछा गया किस आधार पर अपने लोक निर्माण विभाग की भूमि पर हो रहे एवं किए गए अवैध निर्माण में अनापत्ति पत्र निर्गत कर दिया गया जबकि लोक निर्माण विभाग द्वारा इस हो रहे निर्माण को 7 दिन के भीतर हटाने हेतु 10/01/2022 को जारी पत्र को उनको व्हाट्सएप के माध्यम से भेजा तथा उन्हें बताया गया किस प्रकार अवैध निर्माण कर्ता 2015 से लोक निर्माण विभाग की भूमि पर लगातार भ्रष्ट अधिकारियों की सह में अवैध निर्माण करता आ रहा है।

(૩) 	અરજીની રજુઆતમાં જણાવ્યા મુજબ વિવિધ મુદાઓમાં ખોટા આક્ષેપો કરેલ છે. સોસાયટીના દરેક મકાનને જોડતા રોડમાં લાઈટ, પાણીની સુવિધા આપવામાં આવે છે. તેમજ સોસાયટીના નકશાઓ એ ટાઉન પ્લાનર / સરકારશ્રી ધ્વારા મંજુર કરવામાં આવતા હોય છે. જે મુજબ કોમન પ્લોટ અને રસ્તાઓ તેમાં છોડેલા હોય છે. ઈરાદાપૂર્વક સાર્વજનિક પ્લોટમાં રસ્તા બનાવવા બાબતે જણાવવાનું કે સોસાયટીના સાર્વજનિક પ્લોટ અને રસ્તાઓ જે તે વખતે જે તે મુળ જમીન માલિક ધ્વારા લેખિત નગર પાલિકાને સુપ્રત કરેલા હોય છે અને નગર પાલિકાએ સંભાળેલા છે. જેથી ત્યારબાદ જ નગર પાલિકા લાઈટ પાણીની સુવિધા પુરી પાડે છે.

सदस्य ने यह भी सूचित किया है कि उन्होंने अपना नाम सही करवाने हेतु संयुक्त घोषणा पत्र तथा संबंधित दस्तावेज इस कार्यालय को पोस्ट के माध्यम से भेज दिये हैं। चूकिं उक्त संयुक्त घोषणा पत्र तथा संबंधित दस्तावेज इस कार्यालय में प्राप्त नहीं हुए हैं इसलिए सदस्य से speed-post का number मांगा गया परन्तु सदस्य ने कहा कि वह अभी ड्यूटी पर है इसलिए speed-post का number नहीं दे सकता है। इसके अतिरिक्त जैसे ही संयुक्त घोषणा पत्र तथा संबंधित दस्तावेज दस्तावेज कार्यालय में प्राप्त होंगे correction हेतु कार्यवाही अमल में लाई जाएगी । 
सदस्य को यह भी सूचित किया जाता है कि इस कार्यालय के रिकार्ड के अनुसार उनका KYC भी अपडेट नहीं है। अतः नाम correction के पश्चात सदस्य member unified portal के माध्यम से अपना KYC भी seed करें । साथ ही अपने भ. नि. खाता संख्या HPSML/2732/4961 के संदर्भ में नौकरी छोड़ने का कारण एवं नौकरी छोड़ने की दिनाँक भी अपने नियोक्ता से अपडेट करवाएं। 
उक्त details अपडेट करने के पश्चात सदस्य भविष्य निधि राशि निकालने के लिए member unified portal के माध्यम से ऑनलइन आवेदन करें। सदस्य को उपरोक्त सूचना के बारे में दूरभाष के माध्यम से सूचित कर दिया गया है । तथा सदस्य ने आश्वासन दिया है कि जैसी उन्हे सूचना दी गई है उसके अनुसार कार्यवाही अमल में लाएगे । 
सदस्य के नियोक्ता को भी दूरभाष के माध्यम से संपर्क किया गया तथा उनके द्वारा आश्वासन दिया गया कि वे सदस्य की correction हो जाने के पश्चात उनका KYC update करवा देंगे।

In this regard, it is to submit that the value declared by the complainant in his grievance and detention of parcel for two months is contrary to the facts available with PAD. This is to further submit that all import consignments via post are classifed under tariff heading 9804 under Customs Tariff Act, 1975. Accordingly, the duty is levied @ 42.08 percent of assessable value in case of imports via post. Also, 1 SAR is taken as 22.80 INR for the purpose of assessment on the date of presentation of parcel for assessment.

The details regarding the duty levied for consignment no CE018058156SA is as follows-

The vaue declared on the Customs Declaration Form is 1270 SAR which is treated as FOB value of the parcel. Assessable value of the consignment (FOB plus Freight 20 percent of FOB plus insurance 1.125percent of FOB) comes out to be INR 35073 (approx) and duty @42.08percent of assessable value comes out to be 14759 INR. Additional INR 100 is charged by the Postal authority.

Also, the parcel after scanning/examination and assessment was handed over on the same day to the postal authority, who are the sole custodian of goods and responsible for safekeeping, delivery and collection of Customs Duty (if any) related to the cleared parcels.

The applicant was suitably advised to approach the right platform for appealing before the information Commission which he has not utilised. In view of all the above the said information was denied by the CPIO and Appellate Authority in EPFO, Regional Office Bengaluru Malleswaram which was in accordance with the law. In view of the same the complaint filed by the applicant is frivolous, baseless, misleading and without any Public interest and hence may be rejected in summarily. As it result in wastage of the resource of public officers to attend to such complain.

RTI Act, 2005 has an inbuilt appellate mechanism which provides for adjudication of the appeal/complaint by the Appellate Authority at the Govt. department level (FAA) and further by the Central Information Commission/State Information Commission, the second Appellate Authority, at the apex level. If an RTI applicant is not supplied information within the stipulated time of 30 days or 48 hours, as the case may be, or is not satisfied with the information furnished to him, he may, by virtue of Section 19(1) of the Act, prefer first appeal to the first appellate authority (FAA) who is an officer senior in rank to the Public Information Officer. Such an appeal may be filed within a period of 30 days from the date on which the stipulated period of 30 days of supply of information expires or from the date on which the information or decision of the Public Information Officer is received. The FAA of the public authority shall dispose of the appeal within a period of 30 days or in exceptional cases within 45 days of the receipt of the appeal. 2.	Further, as per section 19(3) of the RTI Act 2005, a second appeal against the decision under 19(1) shall lie within ninety days from the date on which the decision should have been made or was actually received, with the Central Information Commission or the State Information Commission. Provided that the Central Information Commission or the State Information Commission, as the case may be, may admit the appeal after the expiry of the period of ninety days if it is satisfied that the appellant was prevented by sufficient cause from filing the appeal in time. 3.	Further, as per section 18(1)(c) of the Act, subject to the provisions of this Act, it shall be the duty of the Central Information Commission or State Information Commission, as the case may be, to receive and inquire into a complaint from any person who has been refused access to any information requested under this Act.

This is in connection with your complaint dated 01.01.2023 received at this office through CPGRAM Portal vide no.DPOST/E/2023/0000025 about premature closure of SSA Account of your daughter opened on dated 23.06.2018 at Ramanagar SO. 

 In this regard, it is to inform you that As per POSB (CBS) manual corrected up to 31.12.2021, accordingly to Sub rule 1of.129 “in the event of death of the account holder, the account shall be closed immediately on application in Account Closure Form SB-7B on production of death certificate issued by the competent authority and the balance at the credit of the account and interest due thereon till the date of death shall be paid to the guardian”.
 
 In further, it is clarified by Sub Rule 3 of 129 that “if it is satisfied that in case of extreme compassionate grounds such as medical support in life threatening diseases of the account holder or death of the guardian that the operation or continuation of the account is causing undue hardship to the account holder, afte complete documentation establishing the grounds for such closure, by order and for reasons to be recorded in writing , premature closure of the account may be allowed. Outstanding balance is the account with interest due as applicable to the Scheme shall be paid to the account holder or guardian , as the case may be. Such closure shall be sanctioned by Head of the Division for the accounts standing in SOs and their BOs /Sr.Post Master or Chief Post Master or Director for the accounts standing in Gazetted HOs/GPOs”.

 As per Sub Rule 4 of 129 “ No premature closure of an account under above sub rule shall be made before completion of five years from the date of opening of the account”.

As your SSA Account is not completion of five years hence there is no any provision to premature the said account in any circumstances . 
 
 However, inconvenience caused to you is deeply regretted .

This is in reference to the concern raised on Public Grievance PG Portal.
We wish to reiterate that your investment was in the Unit Linked Policy wherein
 The policy value depends on the unit price of the fund multiplied by the number of fund units in your account balance 
 The unit price depends on the market conditions and the performance of the funds during the period in which you have invested your money.
Further, as per the Maturity benefit in the Unit Linked plans, the risk cover ceases and the Unit Fund Value is payable. 
The fund option chosen by you for your policy was Highest NAV Guarantee Fund option, in which the Maturity value is calculated as the number of units held by the policy in the Highest NAV Guarantee Fund as on date of Maturity multiplied by the higher of the guaranteed unit price or the unit price on the maturity date.
Hence, the Maturity value payable in your policy is the fund value of INR 684571.07/-
In case you are not satisfied with the above decision, you may write to the second level of escalation within 8 weeks of receipt of this email at the below address or send an email to escalation2@hdfclife.in or visit https://www.hdfclife.com/customer-service/grievance-redressal. The relevant provision of EPS 1995 governing widow pension in cases where there are 2 or more widows are produced below.
16(2) (b)........ Note: - In cases where there are 2 or more widows, family pension shall be payable to the eldest surviving widow. On her death it shall be payable to the next surviving widow, if any. The term eldest would mean seniority with reference to the date of marriage.
 The provision is given in the scheme itself and is available in public domain and is self-explanatory. Regards

NPPA fixes the ceiling price of scheduled medicines specified in the first schedule of the DPCO, 2013. All manufacturers of scheduled medicines have to selltheir products within the ceiling price (plus applicable Taxes) fixed bythe NPPA. DPCO, 2013 allows an annual price rise for scheduled formulations based on Wholesale Price Index (WPI). NPPA also fixes
retail price of a new drug under DPCO, 2013 for existing manufacturers of scheduled formulation. DPCO, 2013 further mandates monitoring of retail prices in respect of non- scheduled formulations allowing an annual price increase of up to 10 percent. Instances of overcharging are dealt with by NPPA under the relevant provisions of DPCO 2013.
ii) With an objective of making generic medicines available at affordable prices to all, Pradhan Mantri Bhartiya Janaushadhi Pariyojana (PMBJP) was launched by the Department of Pharmaceuticals, Ministry of Chemicals & Fertilizers in the year 2008. Under the Scheme, dedicated outlets known as Pradhan Mantri Bhartiya Janaushadhi Kendras
(PMBJKs) are opened to provide generic medicines at cheaper rates to the citizens.iii) All price notifications are available on NPPA web-sitewww.nppaindia.nic.in. The applicant can also search the price of scheduled formulations by using the tool ‘Search Medicine Price’ available on the website of NPPA or through Mobile App ‘Pharma Sahi Daam’.
iv) Any price violation of the provisions of DPCO, 2013 a specific complaint may be made to NPPA at monitoring-nppa@gov.in or by using the nppa prortal at Pharma Jan Samadhan, along with copy of the strip/ pack of the medicine and copy of the bill so that appropriate action can be taken against the concerned company.

2004 का न्यायालय का आदेश, और 18 साल से लिखित में कराई गई प्रतीक्षा, फिर 2022 के नियम क्यो लागू किए जा रहे। जब आवेदक के साथ के 14 जूनियर को नियुक्ति तो हमें भी दी जाये।
क्या मरने के बाद दिया जायेगा न्याय

हमारे 14 जूनियर अतिशेषों को नियुक्ति दी गई जिस पर हाईकोर्ट ने वही लाभ देकर नियुक्ति देने का आदेश‌ दिया। 2004 से बराबर लिखकर प्रतीक्षा कराई कि पद रिक्त होने पर नियुक्ति दी जावेगी। फाईल बराबर रनिंग में रही। पद हुए आदेश भी बने लेकिन भ्रष्टाचार के चलते डिस्पैच न कर फाड़ दिये गये। अत: तत्काल कार्यवाही कर नियुक्ति दिलवाई जाये और 18 साल से आर्थिक मानसिक क्षति पहुंचाने के लिए क्षतिपूर्ति दिलवाई जाये।

माननीय हाईकोर्ट ने आवेदक के जूनियर-सह अतिशेषो को दी गई नियुक्तियों की भांति लही लाभ देते हुए आवेदक को नियुक्ति देने का आदेश दिया। तब से लेकर बार बार लैटर देकर 18 वर्ष तक फाईल को रनिंग में लेकर प्रतीक्षा कराई गई कि भविष्य में पद रिक्त होने पर नियुक्ति दी जावेगी। पद रिक्त होने पर कई बार अनुमोदन होकर आदेश तैयार हुए किन्तु हस्ताक्षर न कर आदेश वितरण नही किये गये। निवेदन है कि कृपया या तो जूनियर को दी गई नियुक्तियों के समान आवेदक को नियुक्ति दी जावे या फिर गलत तरीके से की गई सभी 14 नियुक्तियां निरस्त कर उनको दिये वेतन भत्तों के बराबर मुआवजा दिया जावे और 18 साल प्रतीक्षा कराकर जीवन नष्ट कर दी गई आर्थिक मानसिक पीड़ा की क्षतिपूर्ति दी जावे और यदि न्याय नहीं देते तो सपरिवार आत्मदाह की अनुमति दी जावे।

महोदय:-भारतीय राष्ट्रीय राजमार्ग प्राधिकरण औरंगाबाद कार्यालयाचे मनमानी व नालायक अधिकारी व जालना जिल्ह्यातील नियमबाह्य ब्रिज बाबत तक्रारी आणी अपील सर्व मुद्द्यावर विचार न करता ठराविक मुद्दे चुकीच्या पद्धतीने स्पष्टीकरण देऊन निकाली काढून त्यांच्या मनमानी आणी भ्रष्ट कारभाराला चालना देणारे वरिष्ठ अधिकारी यांना एवढं स्पष्ट पारदर्शक प्रकरण जे रस्ता रुंदीकरण पासूनच जालना जिल्ह्यातील वडीगोद्री,महाकाळा,शहागड येथील ब्रिज निर्माण करताना मनमानी निकष लावुन वेगवेगळ्या गावाला वेगवेगळा मापदंड वापरून ब्रिज निर्माण केले यात प्रथम वडीगोद्री अंडर बाय पास ची आवश्यकता नसताना येथे एकापेक्षा जास्त बोगदे निर्माण केले ज्याची महाकाळा गावाला जे निकष लावले त्या प्रमाणे या गावाला झुकते माप का त्या ब्रिज मधून कोणती वाहने कुठं जातात हे समजेल का कारण जालना जाण्यासाठी स्पेशल मोठा ब्रिज येथे असत

महोदया:-आदरणीय महामहिम राष्ट्रपती महोदया आज 8 मार्च 2023 आज आपण जागतिक महिला दिन म्हणून संपूर्ण देशभर मोठ्या प्रमाणात उत्साहात सेलिब्रेट करतो यशस्वी महिलांचे यशोगाथा त्यांचा सत्कार हे कार्यक्रम मोठया प्रमाणात राबवले जातात महिलासाठी सरकार काय काय करत अधिकारी कसे न्याय देतात या विषयी देखील भरगच्च कार्यक्रम असतात पण खरोखर महिलांना न्याय मिळतोय का खालच्या वर्गातील खेडेगावातील मजूर, शेतकरी, गृहनी यांची परवड होत असेल आणी त्या विरुद्ध त्या न्याय मागत असेल अशा महिलांच्या उपोषण कडे 48 दिवस उन्हात पावसात राष्ट्रीय महामार्ग वर सुरु असलेल्या आंदोलनकडे दुर्लक्ष करुन महाराष्ट्र राज्य परिवहन विभाग,तहसीलदार,जिल्हाधिकारी, प्रकल्प संचालक त्यांना वाऱ्यावर सोडत असतील होळी सणाच्या दिवशी उपोषण,धुलिवंदन या दिवशी तळीरामाचा त्रास होत असतानाही उपोषण मध्ये ठाम रा

ભવિષ્યમાં પ્રધાનમંત્રી આવાસ યોજના(શહેરી) માટે આવાસનું આયોજન અરજદારો પાસેથી અરજી મંગાવી ડીમાંડ સર્વેના આધારે સ્થાનિક સ્વરાજ્યની સંસ્થાઓ જેવી કે, મહાનગરપાલીકા, નગરપાલીકા, શહેરી વિકાસ સત્તામંડળો, ગુજરાત હાઉસીંગ બોર્ડ દ્વારા કરવામાં આવે છે.અને આવાસ યોજનાઓ બહાર પાડવામાં આવે છે તેમજ રેડીઓ, સ્થાનિક દૈનીક સમાચારપત્ર, વર્તમાનપત્ર, દૈનિક વર્તમાન પત્ર, હોર્ડીંગ્સ, ટેલીવિઝન દ્વારા આવાસ યોજના જાહેર કરતા સમયે પ્રચાર પ્રસાર કરવામાં આવે છે. તે સમય દરમ્યાન આપના દ્વારા નિયત અરજીપત્રકમાં જરૂરી પુરાવા સાથે અરજી કરવી.

We thank you, dear Sir, for your suggestion. As you already know, the NI (Amendment) Act, 2018 has been enacted to address the issue of undue delay in final resolution of cheque bounce cases, with an object to provide substantial relief to payees of dishonoured cheques and also discourage frivolous and unnecessary litigation with respect to chq dishonour cases, which would save time and money, and to thereby increase the credibility of the chq as a financial instrument. Another development has been that in WP SMW (Crl) No. 2/2020 initiated suomotu, the Honble Supreme Court had considered the great delay that is occurring in the disposal of cases under the NI Act 1881 which is creating logjam in courts at all levels, particularly, the trial courts and the High Courts. The Honble Supreme Court had heard this matter on 03.03.2021, 04.03.2021 and vide order dated 10.03.2021, the Honble Court had, inter-alia, ordered to constitute a 10-member Committee with the objective of submitting a report specifying the steps that must be taken in order to facilitate an early disposal of cases under the NI Act. The Committee recently submitted its Report to the Honble Court, wherein it, inter alia, also suggested the creation of de novo Special NI Courts. The amici curiae in the matter suggested a pilot study to test this scheme, in 5 judicial districts with the highest pendency in the 5 states with the highest pendency (namely, Maharashtra, Rajasthan, Gujarat, Delhi and UP) so that the viability of the scheme can be examined based on the results of the pilot study. Thereafter, vide its Order dated 19.05.2022, the Honble SC has directed that the pilot study shall be conducted in the manner indicated in the said Order for a duration of 1 year from 01.09.2022 to 31.08.2023, in 25 Special Courts in total. As regards your suggestions regarding amendments to the NI Act, 1881, we have taken note of your suggestions and will keep them in mind.

It is hereby informed that the R. M. Lodha Committee had sought online refund applications vide press release dated February 08, 2019 from investors of PACL Limited. The deadline for filing such online claims was July 31, 2019. If you have not submitted your claims yet, you may await notification from the Committee in this regard.
It is informed that as on date, the Committee has successfully effected refunds with respect to 18,43,010 eligible applications in PACL Ltd. with claims up to Rs. 15,000 aggregating to Rs. 831.78 crore.
The Committee has from time to time provided investors, having claims upto Rs. 10,000 and whose applications were found deficient, opportunity to check status or deficiencies in their claim application and make good the deficiencies so that the applications can be processed. Currently, the Committee has provided facility to rectify the deficiencies in the claim applications of investors with claims upto Rs. 15,000 from 01.11.2022. The last date for rectification of deficiencies is 31.01.2023. 
Further, in case of claim applications where investors have indicated or marked Land Allotted field as Yes or where land has been allotted to the investor as per records provided by PACL, the processing of such claim applications have been kept on hold and payment has not been effected. Such applications will be taken up at a later stage. In cases where Deferred or Endorsed has been mentioned on the PACL Certificate, processing of such cases has also been kept on hold and payment has not been effected.
The updated status pertaining to PACL matters will be made available on SEBI website from time to time and the investors are requested to check the current notifications from the Committee. Further, investors can also check the status of their claim applications online on the portal www.sebipaclrefund.co.in.

remarks: जांच पर आवेदक डिकेश कुमार वर्मा के पिता महेश कुमार वर्मा की रिपोर्ट पर थाना पुरानी भिलाई में मृतक शिवांस वर्मा की मृत्यु की सूचना देने पर मर्ग क्रमांक 106/2022, धारा 174 जा.फौ. कायम कर जांच कार्यवाही में लिया गया। मर्ग सदर में मुख्य चिकित्सा अधिकारी एवं स्वास्थ्य अधिकारी द्वारा समिति गठन कर घटना के संबंध में जांच किया गया, जांच पर सिद्धिविनायक अस्पताल भिलाई 03 के चिकित्सा अधिकारी डाॅ. दुर्गा सोनी, डाॅ. हरिराम यदु, डाॅ. गिरीश साहू एवं नर्सिंग स्टाफ श्रीमती आरती साहू, कुमारी निर्मला यादव के द्वारा बच्चे के ईलाज में लापरवाही बरतने पर धारा 304ए भादवि. का दोषी होना पाया गया। जांच रिपोर्ट प्राप्त पश्चात् उपरोक्त सातों आरोपीगणों के विरूद्व थाना पुरानी भिलाई में अपराध क्रमांक 523/22, धारा 304ए भादवि. का अपराध पंजीबद्ध कर विवेचना में लिया गया। प्रकरण की विवेचना के दौरान प्रकरण में आरोपी समीतराज प्रसाद, हरिराम यदु एवं निर्मला यदु को दिनांक 30.12.2022 को गिरफ्तार कर प्रकरण जमानतीय होने से जमानत मुचलका पर रिहा किया गया है एवं शेष आरोपियों की पता तलाश किया जा रहा है। प्रकरण विवेचना में लंबित है।

अभिलेख उपस्थापित। अभिलेख का अवलोकन किया गया। परिवादी का यह मामला शस्त्र अनुज्ञप्ति निर्गत नहीं करने से संबंधित है। प्राप्त परिवाद के आलोक में बिहार लोक शिकायत निवारण अधिकार अधिनियम, 2015 के प्रावधानों के तहत गृह विभाग में अधिसूचित लोक प्राधिकार-सह-प्रभारी उप समाहत्र्ता (जिला शस्त्र शाखा), गया को नोटिस निर्गत कर विषयांकित परिवाद के आलोक में जाँचोपरान्त आवश्यक विधि-सम्मत कार्रवाई करते हुए कृत कार्रवाई से संबंधित प्रतिवेदन की मांग की गई। तदालोक में लोक प्राधिकार-सह-शस्त्र दण्डाधिकारी, गया द्वारा अपने कार्यालय पत्रांक-31, दिनांक-14.01.2023 द्वारा प्रतिवेदन समर्पित किया गया है, जिसमें प्रतिवेदित किया गया है कि परिवादी श्री चन्दन कुमार, पिता-रामधारी यादव, मुहल्ला-रामपुर, थाना-रामपुर, अनुमण्डल-सदर, जिला-गया के रिवाॅल्वर/पिस्टल की शस्त्र अनुज्ञप्ति निर्गत करने से संबधित जाँच प्रतिवेदन के आलोक में कहना है कि वरीय पुलिस अधीक्षक, गया के पत्रांक-381/गो॰ (शस्त्र), दिनांक-14.11.2022 द्वारा प्रतिवेदन प्राप्त हुआ है। उल्लेखनीय है कि शस्त्र अनुज्ञप्ति निर्गत करने की शक्ति जिला दण्डाधिकारी महोदय को प्रदत्त हैं। इस हेतु अभिलेख जिला दण्डाधिकारी महोदय के न्यायालय में उपस्थापित किया जाता है। उक्त आलोक में अभिलेख सुनवाई हेतु जिला दण्डाधिकारी, गया के समक्ष निदेशानुसार उपस्थापित किया जाएगा। जिला दण्डाधिकारी, गया द्वारा पारित आदेश के आलोक में नियमानुसार अग्रेतर कार्रवाई की जाएगी। लोक प्राधिकार द्वारा समर्पित प्रतिवेदनानुसार उक्त वाद की कार्रवाई समाप्त की जाती है।

This Ministry has examined the issues of returnee Indian medical students from Ukraine elaborately in the Ministry in consultation with the National Medical Commission (NMC) which is the apex medical regulatory body in the country. It is submitted that Foreign Medical Students/Graduates are either covered under Screening Test Regulations 2002 or Foreign Medical Graduate Licentiate Regulations 2021. There are no such provisions in the Indian Medical Council Act 1956 and the National Medical Commission Act 2019 as well as the Regulations to accommodate or transfer medical students from any foreign medical institutes to Indian medical colleges. No permission has been given by the NMC to transfer or accommodate any foreign medical students in any Indian medical institute/university. 
However, in pursuance of directions of Supreme Court of India, NMC, vide Public Notice dated 28.07.22, has devised a scheme under which Indian students who were in the last year of their undergraduate medicine course (due to COVID-19 Russia Ukraine conflict etc had to leave their foreign medical institute) and have subsequently completed their studies and also have been granted certificate of completion of course/degree by the respective institute on or before 30th June 2022 shall be permitted to appear in Foreign Medical Graduate Examination. Thereafter upon qualifying the FMG examination, such foreign medical graduates are required to undergo Compulsory Rotating Medical Internship (CRMI) for a period of two years to make up for the clinical training which could not be physically attended by them during the undergraduate medicine course in the foreign institute as also to familiarize them with practice of medicine under Indian conditions. The foreign medical graduates will be eligible to get registration only after completing the CRMI for two years. Moreover, now the NMC has also agreed to the academic mobility program proposed by Govt. of Ukraine.

Resident can authenticate his Aadhaar through various modes.

 Authentication may be carried out through the following modes:
 
1. Demographic authentication: The Aadhaar number and demographic information of the Aadhaar number holder obtained from the Aadhaar number holder is matched with the demographic information of the Aadhaar number holder in the CIDR.

2. One-time pin based authentication: A One Time Pin (OTP), with limited time validity, is sent to the mobile number and/ or e-mail address of the Aadhaar number holder registered with the Authority, or generated by other appropriate means. The Aadhaar number holder shall provide this OTP along with his Aadhaar number during authentication and the same shall be matched with the OTP generated by the Authority.

3. Biometric-based authentication: The Aadhaar number and biometric information submitted by an Aadhaar number holder are matched with the biometric information of the said Aadhaar number holder stored in the CIDR. This may be fingerprints-based or iris-based authentication or other biometric modalities based on biometric information stored in the CIDR.

4. Multi-factor authentication: A combination of two or more of the above modes may be used for authentication.
 For further details please visit UIDAI resident portal at https://uidai.gov.in/authentication/authentication-overview.html.

Sir,
It is highly disappointing that more than one month has been lapsed since registration of my grievance but till date no resolution has been provided in this regard. The guidelines issued vide F. No. S-15/21/2021-O/o DS(PG)-DARPG (7085) dated 27.07.2022 by DARPG are being violated.
The UR candidates are being suffered and lacking their promotions in various Central Government Offices/Departments/Ministries just because of the negligence by the Government policy which in turn is putting the negative effect on the efficiency of the employees and impacting their overall productivity.
 It is respectfully submitted that all the Ministries/Departments are showing aversion to implement DoPT OM No. 36012/16/2019-Estt. (Res.) dated 12.04.2022 just because of the cumbersome process for De-Reservation of any post and do not want to drag into mess with this reservation system. 
If the Ministries/Departments would get some instructions to implement the said OM in an easy way like HODs of Ministries/Departments would ensure the conditions laid down in the said OM and would be able to give promotion to a UR candidate who is the senior most instead of any reserved candidate who is junior to others. The compelling reason as laid down in the said OM should also be duly noted in the DPC file and this process should be done without prior permission of SC/ST Commission but the concerned Commission should mandatorily be informed immediately after conducting the said DPC with all the details regarding the compelling factors.
Hence it is proposed that such instructions may kindly be issued by DoPT so that it could become possible for all the Ministries/Departments to implement the said OM.
Please take up with CBIC.

Accordingly, each technical Institution shall establish a registry, headed by an employee of the concerned Institution to receive the grievances, where an aggrieved student or person shall send their representation for redressal of their grievance. give two options: -

Yes: - Book ticket without any choice Book Any .
No: - Ticket not booked with your choice.

available berth. And if you do not want to book then you may opt NO option.

subject to availability.

time of booking.

lower berth is allotted to senior citizens on first come, first serve

remarks:
चूंकि शिकायत में उठाया गया मामले एसईसीसी या आवास प्लस डेटा बेस में शिकायतकर्ता का नाम मौजूद नहीं होने की स्थिति में मकानों के आवंटन के अनुरोध से संबन्धित है। यह सूचित किया जाता है कि पीएमएवाई-जी के तहत लाभार्थियों का दायरा SECC 2011 डेटा बेस और 2018 में किए गए आवास प्लस सर्वेक्षण के आधार पर अग्रिम रूप से तय किया गया है।इसलिए, सूची में संशोधन करना संभव नहीं है। पीएमएवाई-जी से संबधित विस्तृत जानकारी योजना के क्रियान्वयन का फ्रेमवर्क से प्राप्त कर सकते है जो वेबसाइट https://pmayg.nic.in/netiay/Uploaded/Guidelines-Hindi_book_final.pdfपर सार्वजनिक तौर से उपलब्ध है।
इस संबंध में यह सूचित किया जाता है कि आप अपना नाम अपने ग्राम पंचायत में दर्ज करा सकता है जिसका उपयोग भविष्य में वर्तमान लक्ष्य के पूरा होने पर आवास आवंटन के लिए किया जा सकता है।
अत उच्च प्राधिकारी से अनुरोध है कि शिकायत को नियत प्रक्रिया के अनुसार बंद करें।

In the instant case, a search and seizure operation was conducted in the case of Chhajer Group on 28.07.2011. During the course of the said search action certain jewellery was found and seized. The assessment u/s 153A/143(3) of the Income Tax Act, 1961 was completed in my case on 28.03.2014 where a demand of Rs.192433/- was determined for the A.Y. 2011-12(Copy Enclosed). Against the said assessment appealed was filed before 
CIT (A). In respect of the said appeal the assessee had opted for VsV, 2020 and Form 5 has been issued in its case. The requested to release the seized jewellery. 
1. The assessee has mentioned here CBDT circular no 286/6/2008_IT (lnv.ll) dated 21/01/2009 wherein it has been stated in Point no 3(b) that seized assets should be released within one month if no demand is determined in the last search and seizure assessment order passed. However, Ld. CIT is the Competent Authority for release of Jewellery.
2. It is pertinent to be mentioned that the assessee did not submit any details or documents regarding search & seizure and details of jewellery.

As no further action is required in this case, hence the above CPGRAM may kindly be rejected/disposed off if deemed fit.

प्रिय निवासी,

आधार (नामांकन और अद्यतन) छठे संशोधन विनियम, 2018 में कहा गया है कि निवासी की जन्म तिथि (DOB) केवल एक बार अपडेट की जा सकती है।

यदि जन्म तिथि (DOB) को निर्धारित सीमा से अधिक अद्यतन करने की आवश्यकता है, तो इसे एक अपवाद हैंडलिंग प्रक्रिया के माध्यम से किया जा सकता है।

नवीनतम एसओपी दिनांक 19/07/2021 के अनुसार, जन्म तिथि (DOB) अपवाद से निपटने की प्रक्रिया में निवासी को नीचे उल्लिखित दस्तावेजों का सेट प्रस्तुत करना होगा, उन मामलों को छोड़कर जब निवासी नामांकन ऑपरेटर द्वारा टाइपो (Typing Error) गलती को ठीक करने के लिए जन्म तिथि (DOB) को अपडेट कर रहे हैं:

	क.) निवासी संबंधित राज्यों के जन्म और मृत्यु पंजीकरण नियम 1999/2000/2002 	के साथ पठित जन्म और मृत्यु पंजीकरण अधिनियम, 1969 के तहत अधिकृत 	प्राधिकारी (संबंधित राज्यों में) द्वारा जारी एक जन्म प्रमाण पत्र प्रस्तुत करता 	है।

 	ख.) निवासियों को यह कहते हुए एक स्व-घोषणा (Self Declaration) प्रस्तुत करनी होगी कि वह 	जन्मतिथि के अद्यतन के लिए अंतिम बार आवेदन कर रहा है।

OfficerDetail: Ms. Chahat Singh (Assistant Commissioner Rural Housing)
remarks:
चूंकि शिकायत में उठाया गया मामले एसईसीसी या आवास प्लस डेटा बेस में शिकायतकर्ता का नाम मौजूद नहीं होने की स्थिति में मकानों के आवंटन के अनुरोध से संबन्धित है। यह सूचित किया जाता है कि पीएमएवाई-जी के तहत लाभार्थियों का दायरा SECC 2011 डेटा बेस और 2018 में किए गए आवास प्लस सर्वेक्षण के आधार पर अग्रिम रूप से तय किया गया है।इसलिए, सूची में संशोधन करना संभव नहीं है। पीएमएवाई-जी से संबधित विस्तृत जानकारी योजना के क्रियान्वयन का फ्रेमवर्क से प्राप्त कर सकते है जो वेबसाइट https://pmayg.nic.in/netiay/Uploaded/Guidelines-Hindi_book_final.pdfपर सार्वजनिक तौर से उपलब्ध है।
इस संबंध में यह सूचित किया जाता है कि आप अपना नाम अपने ग्राम पंचायत में दर्ज करा सकता है जिसका उपयोग भविष्य में वर्तमान लक्ष्य के पूरा होने पर आवास आवंटन के लिए किया जा सकता है।
अत उच्च प्राधिकारी से अनुरोध है कि शिकायत को नियत प्रक्रिया के अनुसार बंद करें।

Hence, no action is pending with this office. This grievance may be transferred to CPC for further necessary action.

The Pension Reforms Division, Department of Financial Services (DFS) deals with the matter related to the National Pension System (NPS) which is applicable to the Central Government employees who joined the service on or after 01.01.2004 and Atal Pension Yojana (APY). As per the Government of India (Allocation of Business) Rules, 1961, Department of Pension & Pensioners Welfare (DoP&PW) deals with the formulation of policy and coordination of matters relating to retirement benefits to Central Government employees. The nature of retirement benefits / what retirement benefits are to be given to Central Government employees is a subject matter in the domain of DoP&PW. Therefore, it is requested to please take up the matter with concerned Department.

આપે અરજીમાં જણાવ્યા મુજબ ઉમરાળા થી પીપરાળી નો કાચો રસ્તો ડામર કરવા જણાવેલ છે. જેમાં આપને જણાવવાનુ કે ઉમરાળા થી પીપરાળી જવા માટે અત્રે ની કચેરી હસ્તક નો ઉમરાળા કેરીયા પીપરાળી રસ્તો છે. જે બાબતે અત્રેની તાબાની કચેરી-પંચાયત માર્ગ અને મકાન પેટાવિભાગ વલ્લભીપુર મારફત તપાસ કરાવતા ઉમરાળા થી પીપરાળી નુ અંતર લગભગ ૬.૮ કીમી થાય છે જ્યારે આપની રજુઆત મુજબનો નવો રસ્તો બનાવતા ઉમરાળાથી પીપરાળી વચ્ચે લગભગ ૫.૩ કી.મી. જેટલુ અંતર રહે છે.એટલે કે આપની રજુઆત વાળો રસ્તો બનાવતા ૧.૫ કીમી જેટલુ અંતર ઘટે છે. તેમજ પીપરાળી ગામ ને જોડતા અન્ય રસ્તા પણ ઉપલબ્ધ હોય આ રસ્તો નવો બનાવવો હિતાવહ ન હોવાનું તેમજ સદર રસ્તો બનાવવા ગ્રામજનો, એમ પી શ્રી/ એમ એલ એ શ્રી ની રજુઆત પણ પેટાવિભાગીય કચેરીને મળેલ ન હોવાનું માલુમ પડેલ છે જે આપને જાણ સારુ.
